description: Create a hosted landing page with a single hero block (headline, subheadline, CTA). Returns the public URL. The real API stores pages as a page-builder block array with no dedicated headline/CTA fields, so this tool translates your inputs into one 'hero' block — for multi-block pages or a real CTA link, use the landing page editor in the MisarMail dashboard.

slug.description: URL slug (auto-generated from name when omitted)
